messages:
maya: Quick Q — p95 TTFT for svc-uk has been climbing since ~02:30 UTC. I need a fast path: where do I look to compare TTFT (p50/p95/p99) vs tokens/sec so I can triage?

liam: Fastest is Grafana + a couple PromQL checks. Grafana panels: /d/abcd/latency-insights (TTFT quantiles) and /d/efgh/tokens-overview (tokens/sec & tokens/request). Filter by service=svc-uk.

liam: PromQL snippets that I use:
```
# p95 TTFT over 5m
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service))
# tokens/sec per service
sum(rate(inference_tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (service)
# tokens per request (useful to spot long outputs)
sum(rate(inference_tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (service) / sum(rate(inference_requests_started_total[1m])) by (service)
```

nora: For traces open Jaeger and search by service + timeframe: https://jaeger.redwood.com/search?service=svc-uk&lookback=1h . Look for the "first_token" span — if that duration is high it's a model/decoder stall; if queue_wait is high it's a scheduling problem.

travis: Logs live in Loki: https://loki.prod.redwood/logs?query=%7Bservice%3D%22svc-uk%22%7D . Quick grep locally:```rdl logs svc-uk --from 3h --query "first_token|enqueue|batch"``` helps find spike-correlated messages. Also check node and gpu labels.

maya: Current alert is p95 TTFT > 500ms for 5m and it's noisy during big batches. Any suggestion for tuning?

liam: Two options: raise threshold or add suppression when tokens/sec > X (i.e., high-throughput valid bursts). Suggested alert change:
```
ALERT TTFTHighP95
IF histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service)) > 0.75
FOR 10m
LABELS {severity="page"}
```
And add a recording rule / condition to ignore short high-throughput windows or require request rate to be moderate.

observability-bot: Pinned dashboards and runbook: latency-insights (grafana/d/abcd), tokens-overview (grafana/d/efgh), traces (jaeger), logs (loki). Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/obs/runbooks/ttft-debug .

nora: Also call out model routing/variant labels when checking tokens/sec. If traffic shifted to a larger model_version or a quantized variant, tokens/sec and TTFT behave differently — include `by (model_version, quant)` in queries.

maya: Nice, that'll do. I'll pull the p50/p95/p99 graphs, check traces for the largest TTFT spans, and correlate tokens/request. Will update thread with findings.

travis: Dropped two example traces in the shared S3 prefix and pinged @oncall-eng-runtime. Links: s3://redwood-dumps/triage/svc-uk/1862345678/trace-1.json (sample) and trace-2.json. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks everyone — filing notes in the incident ticket and will follow up.
